title: Answer to Question: The Repercussions of Turkey's Downing of the Russian Plane!
text:
Answer to Question

The Repercussions of Turkey's Downing of the Russian Plane!

Question:

My question is about the repercussions of the downing of the Russian plane: will this result in an escalation of air force operations in the skies of Syria? And will that extend to the skies of Turkey? Thank you.

Answer:

1- As for the skies of Syria:

- If what is meant by escalation is that warplanes roam the skies of Syria and bomb its land with the people, trees and stones upon it, then this is already happening, and the planes have spared no effort in doing so...

- And if what is meant by escalation is that these planes fight one another and enter into an air war together, then this is unlikely, at least in the foreseeable future, for the reasons we mentioned in our release of 11/10/2015 CE and in the Answer to Question of 18/11/2015 CE.

2- As for the escalation extending to Turkish airspace, as if you mean that an air war breaks out between Russia and Turkey, with Russian planes attacking Turkish planes as a reaction to the downing of the Russian plane... if this is what is meant, then the answer is likewise that it is unlikely, at least in the foreseeable future, for the following reasons:

- The Russian air intervention in Syria took place in agreement with America, and the current Turkish political regime is among the followers of America, and therefore it cannot violate an agreement that America has concluded...

- The evidence of the agreement is plain to see, and we clarified it in the release and the Answer to Question mentioned above... And here is Putin revealing this, saying in Sochi on Tuesday 24 November, describing the incident of the downing of the plane as "a stab in the back" (Radio Sawa, 24/11/2015 CE). This means that an agreement had been concluded and was breached...

- What is most likely is that the downing of the plane took place without a decision from the Turkish political leadership, but rather by leaders in the army with political aims in which they differ with Erdogan, and this was then mixed with their zeal over what they witness of Russian bombing of their Turkmen brothers on their border...

And this is what appeared between the lines, indeed in plain view, in the statement of the Turkish Prime Minister: "Turkish Prime Minister Ahmet Davutoglu, for his part, explained that the decision of the Turkish Armed Forces to shoot down the Russian plane was motivated by the protection of the border..." (Radio Sawa, 24/11/2015 CE).

- Russia most likely realises this, that the Turkish government did not break the agreement, for this is not the first time that Russian planes have violated Turkey's borders without the Turkish government preventing them. And Russia's realisation that the downing of the plane was not a political decision of the government but rather came from some army leaders makes it possible to contain the matter, and consequently makes a war between Russia and Turkey unlikely... Rather, what is expected is that matters will be settled by political means that save face for the parties, such as trade or diplomatic relations, mediations, Russia intensifying its attacks in the areas where the plane was downed, or the like, as a restoration of prestige... And America may have the main role in this, especially in the matter of controlling the army...

In addition to finding ways out in explaining where and how the plane was downed so as to satisfy both parties: an American official said yesterday, 24/11/2015, "that Washington believes the plane was hit inside Syrian airspace after it had briefly penetrated Turkish airspace, according to an assessment based on tracking the plane's heat signature." (Deutsche Welle, 25/11/2015 CE). So here it satisfies both parties!

- And as we mentioned in the answer, "at least in the foreseeable future", meaning according to the visible data; otherwise, the intertwining of military actions with political actions makes the possibility of reversals in events and their outcomes not unlikely...

- Finally, what is painful is that although the lands are Islamic, the outcomes and events in them are controlled by the Kafir colonialists and their agents! Nevertheless, days alternate, and it will not be long, by the permission of Allah, before the light of the Khilafah illuminates the lands of Islam, and indeed extends to the far corners of the earth, and the enemies of Islam retreat into the heart of their own homes... that is, if they still have the heart of a home left to them: "And you will surely know [the truth of] its news after a time."
